mapper.select: SELECT course_id, user_id, source_course_id, name, description, creation_type, view_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM course WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE course_place SET visit_order = ABS(visit_order) + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND visit_order < 0
UPDATE course_place SET visit_order = ABS(visit_order) - 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND visit_order < 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.course_id, c.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_place cp WHERE cp.course_id = c.course_id) AS place_count FROM course c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.place_id, p.name, COALESCE( (SELECT MIN(pi.object_key) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY pi.post_image_id) FROM post_image pi JOIN post po ON po.post_id = pi.post_id AND po.course_id = cp.course_id AND po.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE pi.sort_order = cp.visit_order), p.image_url ) AS image_url, f.floor_code, cp.visit_order, cp.recommendation_reason, cp.visit_status, cp.visited_at FROM course_place cp JOIN place p ON p.place_id = cp.place_id JOIN floor f ON f.floor_id = p.floor_id WHERE cp.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cp.visit_order ASC
SELECT FROM course c WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course ( user_id, source_course_id, name, description, creation_type, view_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{sourceCourseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creationType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO course_place ( course_id, place_id, visit_order, recommendation_reason, visit_status ) VALUES ( #{courseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{placeId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{visitOrder,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{recommendationReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{visitStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

INSERT INTO course_place ( course_id, place_id, visit_order, recommendation_reason, visit_status, visited_at ) SELECT #{createdCourseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, place_id, visit_order, recommendation_reason, #{visitStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL FROM course_place WHERE course_id = #{sourceCourseId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY visit_order
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post p WHERE p.course_id = #{courseId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dual
